name: MsoEditingType
description: Specifies the editing type of a node.

constants.name: msoEditingAuto
constants.description: Changes the node to a type appropriate to the segments being connected.

constants.name: msoEditingCorner
constants.description: Changes the node to a corner node.

constants.name: msoEditingSmooth
constants.description: Changes the node to a smooth curve node.

constants.name: msoEditingSymmetric
constants.description: Changes the node to a symmetric curve node.
